title: Pet Grooming Advertising Ideas to Grow Your Business | Gingr

facts.fact: The article lists four customer categories for pet grooming: busy professionals, families who spoil their pets, value-driven clients, and parents who prioritize the best care.
facts.quote: Most pet grooming customers fall into a few categories:

facts.fact: The article suggests a loyalty perk of a free groom after five visits as an example of a reward for regular clients.
facts.quote: Reward your regulars with loyalty perks — like a free groom after five visits or discounts on add-on services.

facts.fact: The article gives a sample referral campaign offering 15% off as a reward for each client referral.
facts.quote: Try a “Refer a Friend, Get 15% Off” c ampaign or small freebies like nail trims or pet bandanas.

facts.fact: The article gives a sample cross-promotion in which buying a new collar from a pet store gives 10% off the next groom.
facts.quote: Buy a new collar, get 10% off your next groom.

facts.fact: The article suggests targeting social media ads by distance, such as pet owners within 10 miles of the salon.
Gingr customer Heather Manuel of Tails of Hawaii says the salon increased its revenue by 60% in the first year after reopening; this is a testimonial claim, not an independently verified figure.
facts.quote: We increased our revenue by 60% in the first year of reopening!

facts.fact: According to Gingr customer Heather Manuel of Tails of Hawaii, the salon shut down for a year during 2022-2023 before moving into a new facility and regrowing its business.
facts.quote: We shut down for a year in 2022-2023. We moved into a new facility and were quickly able to regrow our business.
